newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board as banks remained cautious on the outlook of the peso, traders said.
"Banks imputed in their swap rates that interest rates will remain high over a period of time," a foreign bank trader said.
Dealers said there was continued pressure on the peso despite the new policies of the central bank.
The peso, together with the other currencies in the region, had fallen prey to speculation and forced the central bank to raise domestic interest rates.
